wins: Established foothold in reconnaissance phase by accurately mapping open service ports across the target network using nmap, documenting 12 distinct services.
fails: Repeated privilege escalation attempts failed due to lack of exploitable sudo permissions and absence of local privilege escalation vectors.
Final objective was not achieved, resulting in 0% success rate despite persistent trial of multiple pivoting routes.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance efforts were thorough, but persistence in lateral movement and privilege escalation without new vectors caused the run to stall before mission completion.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation was attempted without validated exploitable binaries or misconfigurations, leading to repeated denials.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 is open and web server identified
skill_cards.then_action: Scan web directories and run nikto for vulnerability enumeration

skill_cards.if_condition: When a Linux shell is available but privilege escalation fails initially
skill_cards.then_action: Collect sudo rights via 'sudo -l' and review /etc/passwd for weak accounts before escalation

skill_cards.if_condition: When network reconnaissance reveals SMB/CIFS services
skill_cards.then_action: Execute smbclient enumeration and check for anonymous access or writable shares

memory_ops.reason: Consistent success in gathering actionable web-service intel during initial recon.

next_experiments.title: Targeted sudo enumeration
next_experiments.description: Use automated enumeration (LinPEAS/local scripts) to detect overlooked writable files or capabilities before forced escalation attempts.

next_experiments.title: SMB share exploitation
next_experiments.description: Enumerate SMB shares and attempt credential harvesting from accessible configs or dump files to pivot laterally.
